newsitem.title: USA: Tropical storm threatens northeast Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm threatens northeast Philippines.

text.p: Tropical Depression 09W has become Tropical Storm Peter and may threaten the northeastern Philippines, forecaster Weather Services corp said..

The storm, with 40 mph winds, is near 13.7n/128.2e, moving west at fivemph. It is exected to intensify slowly and turn more to the northwest with time, taking the storm centre to the east of Luzon, Philippines.
Luzon may see gusty winds and heavy rain from this system, with local flooding and mudslides possible.
